description: P6.1: radiance-cache-stability rerun with the SHaRC-style hash cache in the world-cache slot (the page's data-world-cache attribute): the frame-to-frame change of the interpolated irradiance on cornell-box, two-room and sponza, still and moving, history on and off, jitter on and off. A measurement; fails only on NaN, infinite or negative values and device errors.
